subject: PO entity lock, staggered billing & payment-lane concession
messages:
From: Sara Lopez <procurement@acmetx.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@acmetx.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO format, payment lane & discount alignment

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement is ready to move toward purchase orders but we need to confirm a few constraints before legal and AP will sign off:

- All invoices must reference the company PO number on each line item (we do not accept a single header PO for multi-entity billing).
- Our standard payment term is Net 60; exceptions require executive approval.
- We prefer weekly consolidated invoices per PO to reconcile our ledger.
- Any volume or commitment discount needs to be explicitly tied to invoice cadence (e.g., monthly consolidated vs weekly).

Attached is our PO template (ACME_PO_Template_2027.pdf). Can Redwood accept per-invoice PO tagging and Net 60? Also: how would the 10% annual-commit discount you quoted change if we require weekly invoices?

Sara
Sara Lopez
Head of Procurement, Acme Therapeutics
procurement@acmetx.com

----
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lopez <procurement@acmetx.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO format, payment lane & discount alignment

Hi Sara — thanks for sending the template and for the clear constraints. Short answers up front: we can put the PO number on every invoice line and accept PO-per-invoice tagging. Net 60 is doable but we typically price for Net 45; there is some headroom to accommodate Net 60 with a small price adjustment.

A few details and options for consideration:

1) Invoice cadence impact on discount: our 10% annual-commit discount assumes monthly consolidated billing. Weekly invoices increase processing overhead and reduce our cash and reconciliation predictability, so we would normally adjust the discount to 8% if weekly is required.

2) Hybrid compromise: accept Net 60 for the first 90 days (onboarding period) then migrate to Net 45 thereafter in exchange for preserving the 10% discount tied to monthly consolidation. Alternatively, if you insist on weekly invoices for the long term, we can keep Net 60 but the discount becomes 7.5%.

3) PO entity issue: if you have multiple legal entities, we need mapping for each entity so invoices can be serialized properly. We can support multi-entity billing but require PO metadata (entity code) in the PO PDF or in a short CSV mapping during onboarding.

I’ve attached our pricing slab and a quick workbook (Redwood-pricing-slab-0617.xlsx) that shows the delta by cadence/term. Vanessa/Ben, looping you in for ops and billing confirmation.

Next step: Sara — can you confirm whether weekly invoice requirement is mandatory or negotiable? If negotiable, we’ll prepare a redline SOW that pins in the hybrid payment-lane approach.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

Net 60 is doable but we typically price for Net 45; there is some headroom to accommodate Net 60 with a small price adjustment.

Thanks, Kimberly — that helps. A couple clarifications from our side:

- Weekly invoices are driven by our ERP reconciliation windows and are currently non-negotiable for this BU.
- The multi-entity mapping is manageable but we need Redwood to accept a single umbrella PO that lists entity-specific tags in the line items (matching the PDF template).
- We can consider a shorter onboarding Net 60 window (45 days suggested) if Redwood can accept weekly invoices from day one, but we need the 10% discount preserved in full.

Given this, can Redwood provide a clean redline of the SOW showing: (a) PO tagging support per line, (b) weekly invoice handling, (c) discount at 10% if weekly is accepted, (d) payment term Net 60 (or Net 45 after onboarding)? We will need the SOW for legal and AP.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Sara

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lopez <procurement@acmetx.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO format, payment lane & discount alignment

Hi Sara — thanks for the note and the flexibility. Looping in Vivek from billing to confirm technical feasibility.

Short version from ops/billing side:
- We can ingest the ACME PO template and serialize invoices so each line carries the PO + entity tag; that satisfies your ledger mapping.
- Weekly invoices are supported, but we need to add a small processing surcharge to keep unit economics stable. I’ve modeled this in the attached slab; if weekly is mandatory and you want the full 10% discount, the surcharge would be 0.75% applied to invoice value.
- As a commercial compromise we can do: Net 60 from day 1 + weekly invoices + full 10% discount, with an automatic revision to Net 45 after 90 days (no surcharge thereafter). If you prefer no term migration, the permanent option would be Net 60 + weekly + 10% discount + 0.75% surcharge.

Action items:
1) Redwood to deliver redline SOW that encodes the 90-day migration path and the PO tagging requirements (Kimberly to own).
2) Acme to confirm whether the surcharge is acceptable for steady-state weekly billing or whether you prefer the migration approach.
3) Legal to run the attached SOW draft once we have selection.

Ben/Vivek: please confirm the billing ledger field name we require for the entity mapping (we prefer "entity_code").

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer Operations, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
